headline: Week 18: The Meaningless Massacre Where T Swift Forgot How To Set A Lineup
subhead: No matchups, no playoffs, just a bunch of grown men leaving 70+ points on the bench in a week that doesn't count.
matchOfTheWeek: There were no matchups, you beautiful idiots — it's Week 18. The real fight was T swift's Baddies vs. T swift's Baddies, where the bench beat the starters by spiritual KO. Tnicolle led the league in scoring AND in self-sabotage, which is a hell of a doubleheader.
powerRankingsShakeup: Nobody's rising, nobody's falling, the season's a corpse — but Little Peckers gets a posthumous bump for Rhamondre Stevenson finally remembering he's an NFL running back in Week 18 of all weeks. Cool, Unc, very useful.
mainRecap:
Welcome to Week 18, the fantasy football equivalent of going to the gym on December 26th. Nobody's watching, nothing matters, and somehow people still found ways to embarrass themselves.

T swift's Baddies put up a league-high 133.46 and STILL deserves to be roasted, because Tnicolle left 71.72 points on the bench. SEVENTY-ONE. Alec Pierce dropped 29.20 in street clothes, Ray Davis added 25.40 from the pine, and the optimal lineup was a casual 205.18. Tnicolle, you didn't lose a matchup — you lost to yourself, in a week with no opponent. That's a new level of L.

The Good Ladds rolled out 47.92 points, which in a SuperFlex league is basically a forfeit notice. Mig56, 3rd Overall Somehow apparently took the week off and so did everyone else on your roster. Moon Man was eclipsed. GOAT Young was a regular goat. Tetty Bear hibernated.

Egbukkake gets the special "What Are You Even Doing" award — Cade Otton dropped 25.90 on the bench and Tyler Shough threw up 22.76 in sweatpants. Szara, QB1.02 must've felt real lonely while you ignored every viable flex.

McBridesStrangeWhiteHock left Riley Leonard's 21.60 on the bench, which is impressive considering nobody on planet earth should've been starting Riley Leonard, and somehow LargestOfRocks still found a way to lose value on him.

Meanwhile QAmon actually showed up — ShAmon-Ra went for 24.90, Turf Toe Joe added 22.14, and KyleDech is the only person who treated Week 18 like it had stakes. Browning Out had Zay Flowers (29.80) and Puka (26.00) hooking up like the season was on the line. Cool stat line for a participation trophy week, fellas.

OnlyFants hit 94.8% lineup efficiency. ChrisCubby out here min-maxing a meaningless week like he's grinding DFS for rent money. Touch grass.
